definitions.gloss: still; as before; as ever; unchanged
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a situation remains the same as before despite the passage of time or changing circumstances. Often used when the lack of change is surprising or noteworthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{依然|いぜん}として⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{依然|いぜん}として⟦{行方不明|ゆくえふめい}→行方不明：14039_yukuefumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ままだ。

⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧にもかかわらず、⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧⟦ダウンロード→ダウンロード：04725_daunroodo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{依然|いぜん}として⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}たない。
examples.english: Despite stricter regulations, illegal downloads still show no sign of stopping.

notes:
{依然|いぜん}として is a formal adverb used mainly in written Japanese and news reporting. It emphasizes that a situation has not changed despite expectations or efforts to the contrary.

The shorter form ⟦{依然|いぜん}→依然：01719_izen⟧ can be used on its own as an adverb with similar meaning, though {依然|いぜん}として is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧: still — neutral and conversational, used in everyday speech
- ⟦{相変|あいか}わらず→相変わらず：01671_aikawarazu⟧: as usual, same as always — more casual, can be positive or negative
- ⟦なお→なお：00305_nao⟧: still, yet — formal, often used in official documents

{依然|いぜん}として is more formal than ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧ and carries a stronger nuance that the unchanged state is significant or problematic.
